about: EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER until club staff confirm the real values (see CLAUDE.md). A practice is a coached or organized rowing session that reserves its boats and holds a lineup. nameMax and notesMax: the longest name and note, in characters. maxHours: the longest a practice can run. maxBoats: the most boats one practice can reserve. daysAhead: how many days ahead a practice can be set up. reasonMax: the longest reason for cancelling a practice or taking someone out of a seat.
